limitations: Rigid sampled poses and nominal-piece guides; physical loading, dumping and shake/drop/transport remain unverified.
Wider board clip and captive hook are unprinted; release force and retention are physical gates. Rounded-cover underside remains pending.
Two new bodies required; previous physical PIP success has no identified version or recorded strength rating.
